Even if it was $50 it's a cheap peace of mind to save a potential $700.
I could be wrong but I don't think quad speed has much to do with a Ham license. Milliwatt rating of the VTX? Definitely. No higher than 1 watt (1000mW =1 Watt) Wattage is a measure of power output.......P= I x R or Power in watts = Voltage times resistance if you're in a circuit. Basic Ohms law.
Lots of Chinese and other suppliers of VTX's will limikt the VTX to 1 watt, with instructions to 'unlock' it to say 1.2 or higher. I know there are 2 watt transmitters now. They do this limiting to be abvle to sell legally in the US if I'm not mistooken.

text: @supafpv1759  Its actually not once you understand whats going on, Honestly. Rx receives a signal and Tx transmits a signal. So in order for any hardware connected to a Fc it is connected the opposite way, otherwise there would be a conflict between the same signals. Think of it like a magnet, opposites attract. The same repel. TX-TX repels TX-RX attracts. Hope this makes it easier to understand.
